title: Public, non-authoritative gate planning and evidence protocol

acceptance.descriptor_binding: GateDescriptor binds gate_id, version (semantic_version), semantic_digest, category, cost_class (INSTANT|LIGHT|MEDIUM|HEAVY|EXTERNAL), depends_on[], applies_when, required_assurance_class, cache_policy, timeout, resource_class, side_effects (typed enum, minimum 'none'), output_schema
acceptance.v2_1_gate_family_addendum: gate_family is a 13-value enum (AUTHORITY_INTEGRITY, CHANGE_GOVERNANCE, SSOT_CANONICALITY, DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY, ARCHITECTURE_BOUNDARY, ARCHITECTURE_DEBT, CONTRACT_COMPATIBILITY, SECURITY, QUALITY, TEST, BUILD_MIGRATION, EXTERNAL_ANALYSIS, REVIEW_PREREQUISITE); descriptor additionally binds authority_domain, canonical_source_refs[], architecture_contract_refs[], supersedes[], non_regression_basis, semantic_review_trigger, input_subjects[], required_when_relevant, excludable
acceptance.execution_key_freeze: execution_key = lowercase-hex SHA-256 over UTF-8 compact JSON array [candidate_tree_sha, work_contract_digest, policy_digest, gate_semantic_digest, toolchain_digest, environment_digest, assurance_class] - serialization frozen in the schema; assurance_class/toolchain/environment are key components, so differing classes are never silently merged and two assurance classes never share a key
acceptance.plan_determinism: GatePlan is deterministic: P0-P5 phase enum ordering, requests sorted ascending by (phase_rank, execution_key), unique keys, intra-plan acyclic depends_on, content-bound plan_digest
acceptance.receipt_and_evidence: GateExecutionReceipt carries assurance_class and a per-execution result (PASS|FAIL|ERROR|SKIPPED|UNAVAILABLE) - never a global GateOutcome; PASS requires >=1 GateEvidenceReference with content_sha256 binding; SKIPPED requires a typed GateSkipReason (never silent); receipt content_sha256 binds canonical content
acceptance.no_global_gate_outcome: no property of any protocol object carries a global GateOutcome; merge decisions remain in conduvera-core (additionalProperties:false everywhere + kit-level outcome scan)
acceptance.identity_collision_rule: the protocol rejects two independent gate definitions claiming the same gate_id + semantic_version + authority_domain with different semantic_digest (schema identity rule + test-kit enforcement)
acceptance.skip_typing: GateSkipReason is a typed enum (NOT_APPLICABLE_CHANGED_PATHS, ASSURANCE_CLASS_MISMATCH, CACHE_HIT, POLICY_DISABLED, DEPENDENCY_FAILED, P0_P1_BLOCK, NON_QUALIFYING_CHANGE, ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE, EXCLUDED_BY_POLICY) with mandatory detail

protocol_tests.rule: all negatives fail closed for their declared reason; frozen derivation/determinism/binding/collision rules enforced by the kit
protocol_tests.validator_note: kit implements the published keyword subset INCLUDING minimal draft-2020-12 allOf/if/then/else (D0 lesson) and adds the frozen D8 rule layer: execution-key derivation, plan determinism (P0-P5 order, unique keys, acyclic deps, digest binding), receipt content binding, PASS-needs-evidence, SKIPPED-needs-reason, global-outcome scan, identity-collision detection

cross_repo_handoff: RELEASE-COMMIT-SHA + the six schema digests above are the only admissible cross-repo handoff for D8_GATE_PLAN_ENGINE, D9A, D9B
